description: Get the original-language (German) full text of one Austrian court decision, by Geschäftszahl (with court), by ECLI, or directly by a RIS document_id from at_search_case_law. ECLI and document_id carry the court (VfGH/VwGH/OGH) in their own format and resolve it automatically; a bare geschaeftszahl needs court passed explicitly. Returns decision date, legal/subject area, headnote and norms cited alongside the text, paged via text_offset/text_has_more/text_next_offset. Source: Bundeskanzleramt (Austria), Rechtsinformationssystem (RIS), Judikatur.

court.description: "vfgh", "vwgh" or "justiz" — required with geschaeftszahl, optional override otherwise.

document_id.description: RIS document id from at_search_case_law, e.g. "JJT_20040525_OGH0002_0140OS00062_0400000_000".

text_offset.description: Character offset for paging long decision text (default 0).

name: at_get_decision
title: At Get Decision
